description: This Java class, HttpClient, provides functionality for performing HTTP POST requests, including handling redirects and constructing POST data from parameters. It also includes logging and error handling, serving as a utility for HTTP communication within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: HttpClient
classes.description: A utility class that performs HTTP POST requests, supports redirect handling, and constructs form data from parameters.

methods.name: HttpClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the HttpClient with a URL string or HttpUrl object.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request with given parameters, handling redirection and returning the server response as a string.

methods.name: constructData
methods.description: Builds URL-encoded form data from a map of parameters to be sent in the POST request.

methods.name: isInvalidPostVariable
methods.description: Checks if a POST variable key or value is null, indicating it should be ignored.
